title: Dean of the study class and the work of a past master
summary: Caldwell teaches new masons their degrees and urges past masters to stay active.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up under segregation: schools, neighborhoods, Jim Crow

blocks.x: What do you do in the lodge now?

Well, I was dean (unintelligible). Well, I've been off and on dean of the study class, class instruction. We catch these new members as they come in, and we (unintelligible) give them the first degree (unintelligible). They got to be prepared and be proficient in the first degree pamphlet and become proficient in the second degree pamphlet. Then we give them the ritual. They got to come back to prove proficient in the third degree pamphlet of ritual because that's when we teach them how to protect the ring and the pin, certain things you do and certain things you don't do.
So I mean you -- I know sometimes after the -- after the people have reached, become the worshipful master, then they rather lose interest.

Some of them do. In fact, some of them never come back. Now, this -- lotte time -- all these fellows have passed (unintelligible) worshipful mastership, whenever we have any committee meetings and communication night, you see more past masters than you see almost the (unintelligible) officer. So I always get up and tell them, I says, look, all you appointed officers, you elected officers, I say, you have a duty to perform. So now, if you expect to go anywhere, I said, because the highest honor is becoming master for the lodge, said, you [run] across a white mason, and he's a big man in his fraternity, masonic fraternity, and you get to talking, the first (unintelligible) you tell him where you travel and how far you went, when you said you're a master, he know you have worked, because there's no honorary master, no honorary past master.

You can get the honorary past potentate degree, see, but you can't no past -- get no past master degree. You got to work for that. Same as in the Royal Arch Chapter. You can't get no honorary past high priest. I'm a past high priest in my Royal Arch Chapter, which is the oldest, and historian too, and I'm chairman of the trustee board.
